question: ________ refers to unsolicited commercial emails that flood the Internet.
solution:
The correct answer is **Spam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Spam** refers to unsolicited commercial emails that flood the Internet.
 
• These emails are often sent in bulk to a large number of recipients.
 
• Spam emails can contain advertisements, promotions, or fraudulent content.
 
• They can be annoying and may also pose security risks by containing malicious links or attachments.
